title: Opening Shot Stills
eyebrow: Bank Robbery MV · ALT · scene 1 · clean room round 2
heading: Scene 1: the opening shot, new stills
intro: Clean room: fresh web research on Nano Banana 2.1 (nb21-research.md), then four sealed writers who saw only Jack's words, the research and an honest list of what looked like AI slop last time. Main changes: dry streets instead of wet glossy ones, one real light source, an off-centre tilted angle, a specific place (Chicago's elevated railway), and colour that comes from something physical (prism glass, sparks, a gelled lamp, a smeared windscreen) instead of pasted-on neon. Stills only, nothing animated yet. Click any image to see it large. Pick one per row and leave notes.

sections.h: Round 2: the new stills (Nano Banana 2.1, two takes each)
sections.lede: Pick the better take per staging, or neither.

groups.title: 1. Back seat of the getaway car
groups.line: Prism bands from old rippled window glass; dry street under the El.

groups.title: 2. From up on the El, looking down
groups.line: Train-wheel sparks through a prism; one theatre canopy of bulbs.

groups.title: 3. Police car windscreen
groups.line: Half-wiped glass smears the lights; muzzle flash, the L overhead.

groups.title: 4. Dusk, no rain, out of the alley
groups.line: Magenta-gelled lamp in the dust; a giant flame as a double exposure.
